stories.text: 🪦 FRESH OBITUARY: Joe's Scary Team has been laid to rest (14.72 pts short). Read it on the Death Watch tab, and bring tissues.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy vs Mr. Action Jackson, playoff odds win/loss: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy 58%/18%, Mr. Action Jackson 78%/40%.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: Claremont In Yo Stace! vs The Mahomies. Playoff odds with a win / loss: Claremont In Yo Stace! 86% / 54%, The Mahomies 34% / 5.4%.
✅ CLINCHED: Brock You Like a Hurricane has locked up the #1 seed and a bye.

🤝 HINDSIGHT DEPT.: 5 weeks ago we said The Mahomies should get Bo Nix and Parker Washington from Ramosverse. Since: Bo Nix and Parker Washington 138.84 pts, Devaughn Vele and Jeremiyah Love 40.40 pts.
🎯 TWO WINS: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy: 67% playoff odds with 2 wins this week, 15% with none (now 43%).
🚪 BYE WATCH: Mr. Action Jackson needs to beat Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy to stay in the bye race (8.4% with a win, 0.6% with a loss).
🚪 BYE WATCH: Ruffing the Passer needs to beat Ramosverse to stay in the bye race (6.8% with a win, 0.6% with a loss).
🗑️ BARGAIN BIN: The Mahomies (9-13)'s healthy bench averages 35% rostered across ESPN.
🏈 6 matchups are still up for grabs, and Claremont In Yo Stace! vs The Mahomies (The Mahomies 59%) is the tightest.
🎲 Claremont In Yo Stace! is rolling with 2 kickers and 3 TEs (LaPorta, Andrews and Strange). It's a bold strategy, Cotton. Let's see if it pays off for 'em.
🛒 WAIVER WIRE MVP: Ramosverse's pickups have put 472.18 pts into its starting lineup this season, led by Stroud (150.38 pts) and McLaughlin (91.00 pts).
📈 Ruffing the Passer was down to 0.5% against Kirbo Crushers — and won.
💓 Brock You Like a Hurricane outlasted 49er Faith-Fool after the favorite flipped 9 times.
